spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin on a new 20-day high close beyond the prior marker, exiting within 2-6 bars.
assumptions: Long-side compiled as testable core; short-side on new 20-day low is omitted because direction allows only one side.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: stop below the latest triggering high/low marker is a variable price-level stop, not a fixed % or ATR multiple; no stop encoded.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: previous marker at least 3 sessions prior approximated by requiring recent 3-bar high does not exceed the 20-bar high from 3 bars ago; exact marker identity not tracked.
Entry fill at next bar open per engine approximates next-day entry at watermark.
Exit of 2-6 candlestick intervals compiled as fixed max_hold_bars with sweep over 2-6.
highest_high(N) already excludes the current bar, so close gt highest_high(20) at offset 0 compares close beyond prior 20 bars without double-lagging.

evidence.quote: Buy entry is placed on the next day
The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker.
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior

audit_majors: direction: Claim describes both new 20-day high and new 20-day low signals; spec encodes long-side only and omits short-side on new 20-day low.
stop_loss_pct: Claim requires stop below latest triggering high/low marker; spec encodes no stop. Leaving out a loss-cutting stop changes what is being tested.
